J&K Official Denies Allegations of Irregular Recruitment

Sakina Itoo has denied allegations of backdoor appointments in Jammu and Kashmir, stating that all recruitment processes are merit-based. The Jammu and Kashmir government has also issued a rebuttal to these claims, emphasizing the integrity of its hiring procedures. This exchange highlights ongoing scrutiny of government recruitment practices in the region.
